title: KATETO: making the deep researcher
description: The Deep researcher is a new agent that will be made to be used with other agents, its role is for creating reports about what the agent wants to know, and the agent will search with the MCPs Duck Duck Go, Context 7, Mempalace, even files of a folder to find information. It will also support 3 modes: Simple (Will search fast, and try the MCPs with most chance to get information), Medium (Will divide the topic into 5 subtopics, search them and then add all into a report), Ultra (Will loop -> make a series of questions -> Search the questions -> Is the original topic resolved? -No-> Make more questions -> Continue). The deep researcher will tell the agent what sources it got it from

data.description: KATETO is an advanced autonomous research agent designed to generate comprehensive reports by leveraging multiple MCP tools, including Duck Duck Go, Context 7, Mempalace, and local file systems. It features three distinct operational modes—Simple, Medium, and Ultra—to adapt its depth and methodology to the complexity of the inquiry, ensuring thorough information gathering. The agent provides full transparency by citing all sources used during the research process.
project_values: Enables autonomous, multi-source data synthesis for complex decision-making
Offers scalable research depth through adaptive Simple, Medium, and Ultra modes
Ensures traceability and trust through explicit source citation
Integrates diverse data streams including web, memory, and local files
dependencies: Integration adapters for Duck Duck Go, Context 7, and Mempalace
LLM orchestration framework for agent coordination

pbi.title: KATETO Core Agent Orchestration & Mode Selection
pbi.description: Implement the central orchestration logic for KATETO that initializes the agent, selects the appropriate operational mode (Simple, Medium, or Ultra) based on user input complexity, and coordinates the lifecycle of the research process. This epic serves as the foundation for all subsequent research capabilities.
pbi.notes: Requires tight integration with the LLM orchestration framework. Chaos will design the state machine, Kateto will implement the logic.

criteries.given_clause: The user submits a research query
criteries.when_clause: The agent evaluates the query complexity
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent sets the operational mode to Simple, Medium, or Ultra accordingly

criteries.given_clause: The operational mode is set to Ultra
criteries.when_clause: The agent begins the research cycle
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent must initialize all three MCP tool integrations (Duck Duck Go, Context 7, Mempalace)

pbi.title: As a researcher, I want KATETO to fetch real-time web data via Duck Duck Go
pbi.description: Enable KATETO to perform web searches using the Duck Duck Go MCP adapter. This feature is critical for the 'Simple' and 'Medium' modes to gather current information from the web.
pbi.notes: Ensure rate limiting and error handling for network requests are included.

criteries.given_clause: The agent is in Simple or Medium mode
criteries.when_clause: The agent identifies a need for external web data
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent invokes the Duck Duck Go MCP tool to retrieve search results

criteries.given_clause: The web search returns no results
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent logs a warning and attempts an alternative query or proceeds with available data

pbi.title: As a researcher, I want KATETO to access structured knowledge via Context 7
pbi.description: Integrate the Context 7 MCP adapter to allow KATETO to query structured documentation and knowledge bases. This enhances the 'Medium' and 'Ultra' modes by providing deeper, more reliable context than raw web search.
pbi.notes: Requires mapping user queries to specific Context 7 repositories or topics.

criteries.given_clause: The agent determines the query requires structured data
criteries.when_clause: The agent calls the Context 7 MCP adapter
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent retrieves relevant documentation snippets based on the query context

criteries.given_clause: The Context 7 response contains multiple documents
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent ranks the documents by relevance to the original query

pbi.title: Implement Mempalace memory retrieval for Ultra mode
pbi.description: Develop the logic for KATETO to interact with the Mempalace MCP tool. This allows the agent to recall past interactions or stored insights, which is a key differentiator for the 'Ultra' mode's depth.
pbi.notes: Focus on efficient retrieval strategies to avoid memory bloat.

criteries.given_clause: The agent is in Ultra mode
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent queries Mempalace for relevant past interactions or stored data

criteries.when_clause: The agent incorporates them into the research plan
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent cites the memory source appropriately in the final report

pbi.title: As a user, I want KATETO to synthesize a final report with full source citation
pbi.description: Implement the final synthesis phase where KATETO aggregates data from all active sources (Web, Context 7, Mempalace, Local Files) and generates a comprehensive report. Crucially, every claim must be traced back to its source.
pbi.notes: This is the core value proposition. The citation format must be explicit and machine-readable.

criteries.given_clause: The agent has gathered all necessary data
criteries.when_clause: The agent generates the final report
criteries.then_clause: Then the report includes explicit citations for every factual claim made
Then the user can verify the source of any claim by clicking the citation link

pbi.title: Configure Local File System access permissions for KATETO
pbi.description: Set up the necessary permissions and adapters for KATETO to read from and write to the local file system. This is required for the 'Ultra' mode to analyze local datasets or save generated reports.
pbi.notes: Security review required to ensure KATETO only accesses authorized directories.

criteries.given_clause: The user grants local file access
criteries.when_clause: The agent starts in Ultra mode
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent can read files from the designated research directory

criteries.given_clause: The agent attempts to access an unauthorized directory
criteries.when_clause: The agent tries to read the file
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent receives a permission denied error and logs the attempt

pbi.title: Fix citation formatting inconsistency in Medium mode reports
pbi.description: Investigate and resolve an issue where citations in Medium mode reports sometimes lack the source URL or document ID, making it difficult for users to verify information. This affects the 'traceability and trust' project value.
pbi.notes: Regression test needed after the last Context 7 integration update.

criteries.given_clause: The agent generates a report in Medium mode
criteries.then_clause: Then every citation must contain a valid source identifier and URL

pbi.title: As a user, I want to switch between Simple, Medium, and Ultra modes dynamically
pbi.description: Allow the user to specify the research depth at the start of a session or dynamically during the process. This ensures the agent adapts to the complexity of the inquiry as defined in the project values.
pbi.notes: UI/UX design for mode selection is assumed to be handled by the frontend team.

criteries.then_clause: Then the agent utilizes all available MCP tools and performs deeper analysis

criteries.given_clause: The user switches from 'Simple' to 'Medium' mode
criteries.when_clause: The agent re-evaluates the current state
criteries.then_clause: Then the agent expands its search scope to include Context 7 sources

draft_sprints.goal: Establish Core Orchestration and Basic Web Research Capabilities
draft_sprints.description: This sprint focuses on laying the foundation for KATETO. Chaos will design the state machine for mode selection, and Kateto will implement the central orchestration logic to initialize the agent and select modes (Simple, Medium, Ultra). Concurrently, the Duck Duck Go integration will be implemented to enable basic web searching, which is critical for Simple and Medium modes. The Local File System permissions will also be configured to ensure the agent has the necessary access rights for future Ultra mode requirements. The dynamic mode switching User Story will also be completed to allow users to interact with these new capabilities.

draft_sprints.goal: Integrate Structured Knowledge and Memory Systems for Deep Research
draft_sprints.description: With the core orchestration and web search in place, this sprint targets the 'Medium' and 'Ultra' mode enhancements. Kateto will implement the Context 7 MCP adapter to allow querying structured documentation and knowledge bases, including relevance ranking logic. Simultaneously, the Mempalace memory retrieval logic will be developed for Ultra mode, enabling the agent to recall past interactions and stored insights. These integrations rely on the permissions and orchestration established in Sprint 1.

draft_sprints.goal: Deliver Final Report Synthesis and Ensure Data Integrity
draft_sprints.description: The final sprint focuses on the core value proposition: generating comprehensive, cited reports. Kateto will implement the final synthesis phase that aggregates data from all active sources (Web, Context 7, Mempalace, Local Files) and ensures every factual claim is traced back to its source with explicit, machine-readable citations. Additionally, a critical bug fix will be performed to resolve citation formatting inconsistencies in Medium mode reports, ensuring traceability and trust before the feature is considered complete.

tasks.title: Design KATETO State Machine for Mode Selection
tasks.description: Design the state machine logic that evaluates query complexity and determines the appropriate operational mode (Simple, Medium, or Ultra). This design must define the transitions between modes and the initialization requirements for each state, serving as the blueprint for the orchestration logic.

tasks.title: Implement Central Agent Orchestration Logic
tasks.description: Implement the core orchestration logic based on the state machine design. This includes initializing the agent, handling the mode selection logic (Simple/Medium/Ultra), and coordinating the lifecycle of the research process. Ensure the logic correctly triggers the initialization of specific MCP tools based on the selected mode.

tasks.title: Implement Duck Duck Go MCP Adapter Integration
tasks.description: Develop the integration with the Duck Duck Go MCP tool to enable real-time web searching. Implement error handling for network requests and rate limiting. Ensure the agent can successfully retrieve search results when in Simple or Medium modes and handle cases with no results gracefully.

tasks.title: Configure Local File System Access Permissions
tasks.description: Set up the necessary permissions and adapters for KATETO to interact with the local file system. Implement security checks to ensure the agent only accesses authorized directories and logs permission denied errors for unauthorized access attempts. This prepares the foundation for Ultra mode requirements.

tasks.title: Implement Dynamic Mode Switching Logic
tasks.description: Implement the logic that allows users to specify or switch research depth (Simple, Medium, Ultra) dynamically. The agent must re-evaluate its state and expand or contract its search scope (e.g., adding Context 7 sources when switching to Medium) based on the user's input.

tasks.title: Validate Orchestration and Web Search Integration
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end testing of the core orchestration and Duck Duck Go integration. Verify that mode selection correctly initializes the agent and that web searches return valid results. Document any issues found during the state machine implementation.

data.goal: Integrate Structured Knowledge and Memory Systems for Deep Research
data.description: With the core orchestration and web search in place, this sprint targets the 'Medium' and 'Ultra' mode enhancements. Kateto will implement the Context 7 MCP adapter to allow querying structured documentation and knowledge bases, including relevance ranking logic. Simultaneously, the Mempalace memory retrieval logic will be developed for Ultra mode, enabling the agent to recall past interactions and stored insights. These integrations rely on the permissions and orchestration established in Sprint 1.

tasks.title: Implement Context 7 MCP Adapter with Relevance Ranking
tasks.description: Develop the integration logic for the Context 7 MCP adapter. This includes mapping user queries to specific repositories/topics, retrieving documentation snippets, and implementing the logic to rank returned documents by relevance to the original query. This directly supports the 'Medium' and 'Ultra' mode capabilities defined in PBI 'As a researcher, I want KATETO to access structured knowledge via Context 7'.

tasks.title: Develop Mempalace Memory Retrieval Logic
tasks.description: Implement the interaction logic with the Mempalace MCP tool for Ultra mode. Focus on efficient retrieval strategies to query past interactions or stored insights without causing memory bloat. Ensure that retrieved memory snippets are correctly cited in the final research plan as per the acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Fix Citation Formatting Inconsistency in Medium Mode
tasks.description: Investigate and resolve the regression where citations in Medium mode reports lack source URLs or document IDs. Implement a validation step in the synthesis phase to ensure every citation contains a valid source identifier and URL, restoring traceability and trust.

tasks.title: Integrate Local File System Access Permissions
tasks.description: Configure and secure the local file system access for KATETO. Set up the necessary adapters to allow Ultra mode to read from authorized research directories and write reports. Implement strict permission checks to ensure unauthorized directory access is denied and logged, satisfying the security requirements.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing for Medium and Ultra Mode Integrations
tasks.description: Conduct integration testing to verify that Context 7 and Mempalace tools function correctly within their respective modes. Validate that relevance ranking works for Context 7, memory retrieval is efficient for Mempalace, and that the final report synthesis correctly aggregates data from all active sources with proper citations.

data.goal: Deliver Final Report Synthesis and Ensure Data Integrity
data.description: The final sprint focuses on the core value proposition: generating comprehensive, cited reports. Kateto will implement the final synthesis phase that aggregates data from all active sources (Web, Context 7, Mempalace, Local Files) and ensures every factual claim is traced back to its source with explicit, machine-readable citations. Additionally, a critical bug fix will be performed to resolve citation formatting inconsistencies in Medium mode reports, ensuring traceability and trust before the feature is considered complete.

tasks.title: Implement Final Report Synthesis Engine with Citation Mapping
tasks.description: Develop the core logic for aggregating data from Duck Duck Go, Context 7, Mempalace, and Local File System sources. Implement the algorithm that maps every factual claim in the generated report to its specific source identifier (URL, Document ID, or Memory Key) to ensure machine-readable traceability.

tasks.title: Define and Enforce Machine-Readable Citation Schema
tasks.description: Design the JSON structure for citations that includes source type, ID, and snippet context. Implement validation logic within the synthesis engine to ensure no claim is published without a corresponding valid citation object, addressing the 'traceability and trust' value.

tasks.title: Fix Medium Mode Citation Formatting Inconsistency
tasks.description: Investigate the regression in Medium mode where citations lack source URLs or document IDs. Fix the Context 7 integration logic to ensure all retrieved snippets are correctly tagged and formatted in the final output. Add unit tests to prevent future regressions.

tasks.title: Integrate Local File System Data into Synthesis Pipeline
tasks.description: Ensure the synthesis engine correctly reads and cites data from the Local File System adapter configured in the 'Ultra' mode. Verify that file content is properly parsed and attributed in the final report, handling edge cases for large files.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing of Citation Integrity Across Modes
tasks.description: Execute comprehensive tests for Simple, Medium, and Ultra modes. Verify that every claim in the generated reports has a valid, clickable, or copy-pasteable citation. Validate that the bug fix for Medium mode persists and that Ultra mode correctly utilizes all four data sources.
